title: Outgoing webhooks
description: Send Aphel events to other systems. Each delivery is a JSON POST signed with the endpoint's secret.
emptyDescription: Add a URL to receive events such as deal won or contact created.
docsHint: See the body format and how to verify the signature in docs/api/webhooks.md.
disabledByFailures: Automatically disabled on {{date}} after several failed deliveries. Fix the destination and re-enable it.

toast.testFailed: The endpoint did not accept the test event

deleteDescription: {{url}} will stop receiving events and its delivery history will be erased.
rotateDescription: The current secret stops working immediately, including for pending retries. Update the destination system right away.

form.description: Aphel sends a POST with the event as JSON to this URL.
form.urlHint: Must be public. Internal addresses (localhost, private networks) are blocked.
form.allEvents: All events, including ones added in the future

errors.urlTooLong: The URL can have at most 2048 characters.
errors.urlNotAllowed: This URL isn't allowed: it points to an internal address or doesn't use https.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description can have at most 255 characters.
errors.tooMany: This organization already has the maximum number of endpoints (20).
errors.versionConflict: Someone else changed this endpoint. Close and reopen it to see the current version.

secret.title: Signing secret
secret.description: Copy it now: for security it won't be shown again. Use it to verify the X-Aphel-Signature header.
secret.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.description: History of the last 30 days. Failed deliveries are retried for up to 24 hours.

incoming.title: Incoming webhooks
incoming.description: Secret URLs that receive data from other systems (website forms, landing pages, automations) and create or update records in the CRM. Actions run with the permissions of the webhook's creator.
incoming.emptyDescription: Create a webhook to turn form submissions into contacts and deals.
incoming.noActions: No actions: requests are only logged

delete.title: Delete webhook?
delete.description: The URL for "{{name}}" will stop working and its log will be erased. This action cannot be undone.

regenerateToken.title: Generate new URL?
regenerateToken.description: The current URL for "{{name}}" stops working immediately. Update the systems that send to it.

rotateSecret.title: Generate signing secret?
rotateSecret.description: A new secret will be generated for "{{name}}" and the previous one will stop working. From now on, every request needs the X-Aphel-Signature header.

removeSecret.title: Remove signature?
removeSecret.description: "{{name}}" will accept requests without the X-Aphel-Signature header again.

actionHelp.upsert_contact: Creates the contact or, if the email already exists, updates only the received fields. Name is required.
actionHelp.create_deal: Creates the deal in the chosen stage, linked to the contact from the previous action. Title is required.
actionHelp.create_activity: Logs the activity linked to the deal and contact created earlier. Title is required.

actions.heading: {{position}}. {{type}}
actions.matchEmail: Update the contact with the same email
actions.matchPhone: Update the contact with the same phone or mobile
actions.matchField: Update the contact with the same value in a unique field
actions.matchFieldLabel: Unique field used to find the contact
actions.noUniqueFields: No unique custom contact field. Mark a field as unique in the field settings.
actions.expressionHelp: Use $.path to read the received body ($.lead.email, $.items[0].name), {{template}} inside text, or a fixed value. Fields missing from the request are ignored. * = required.

form.description: Define what happens with each received request. The configuration is validated against the CRM fields on save.
form.name: Name
form.actionsHelp: Run in order on every request. If one fails, the previous ones are kept and the partial result is logged.
form.noActions: No actions. Add one or use the website form template (contact + deal).

errors.tolerance: Enter a value between 30 and 86400 seconds.
errors.duplicateField: Each CRM field can only be mapped once.
errors.matchFieldRequired: Choose the unique field and map a value to it.

credentials.title: Credentials for {{name}}
credentials.description: Copy them now: the URL and secret won't be shown again. Anyone with the URL can send data to the CRM.
credentials.exampleDescription: The full URL is only shown when creating the webhook or generating a new URL; here it is abbreviated.
credentials.exampleHelp: Form submission with the fields used in the mapping.
credentials.exampleNoActions: Configure actions so the request creates records.
credentials.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

log.title: Log for {{name}}
log.description: Requests received in the last 30 days. Sensitive headers aren't stored and the body is truncated at 8 KB.
log.emptyDescription: Received requests appear here with the result of each action.
